name: @lettland/bb-plugin-dir-skills
description: Inject bb skills into a thread only when its workspace lives under a configured directory, for every provider.

bb.name: Directory skills
bb.description: Skills scoped to a directory tree: a skill listed in scopes.json is injected only into threads whose workspace (or project checkout) is under that directory. A scope can also switch Claude Code threads to its own Claude profile. Skills work for every provider.
